parts.script:
Emma: Hey, Jake! Do you have any plans for the weekend?  
Jake: Not yet, why?  
Emma: I was thinking we could take a trip to the beach.  
Jake: That sounds great! Which beach are you thinking of?  
Emma: I was thinking about Sandy Cove. It's about an hour's drive from here.  
Jake: Perfect! What time do you want to leave?  
Emma: How about 9 AM? We could grab some breakfast on the way.  
Jake: Sounds good to me! Do you want to pack some food or eat at a café there?  
Emma: Let's pack some snacks and maybe have lunch at a café when we arrive.  
Jake: Good idea! Should we invite anyone else?  
Emma: I think Sarah might like to join us. I’ll text her.  
Jake: Great! Let me know what she says.  
Emma: Will do! Are you bringing your camera? I’d love to take some pictures.  
Jake: Definitely! I’ll make sure to charge the battery.  
Emma: Awesome! It’s going to be a fun trip!  
Jake: I can't wait!  
Emma: Me too!
